extracted.intended_audience: general readers interested in television news, features, lists, and reviews
extracted.subtask_description: An index/listing page of TV-focused journalism (news, features, lists, and reviews) on a cultural website showing article headlines, authors, dates, and for reviews, letter-grade ratings. It's intended as a navigational/summary page for TV coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review rating (letter grade)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviews on the page are labeled with a letter-grade rating (examples shown: A, A-, B+, B, B-, C+).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page shows letter grades adjacent to review headlines (e.g., "Devil In Silver — Rating B-", "Jack Thorne's Lord Of The Flies finds fresh terror... Rating A-", "Olivia Rodrigo... Rating C+"). No explanation of the grading scale, criteria for assigning specific letters, or scoring rubric is provided on this listing page.
